---
title: "`r params$title`"
report-class: trade
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    md_extensions: "-native_divs-native_spans"
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  word_document: default
params:
  title:       "Trade"
  name:        ""
  desc:        ""
  class:       "trade"
  image_file:  NULL
  logos:       NULL
  info_df:     NULL
  main_plot:   NULL
  draw_file:   NULL
  routes_df:   NULL
  trade_df:    NULL
  aeff_df:     NULL
  invcost_df:  NULL
  fixom_df:    NULL
  varom_df:    NULL
  capacity_df: NULL
  map_plot:    NULL
  levcost_df:  NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---

```{r en-setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

fmt <- energyRt::report_setup()
tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4L, ...)
  energyRt::report_tbl(df, caption, digits, output = fmt, ...)
emit_img <- function(path, frac = 1)
  energyRt::report_img(path, frac, output = fmt)
.LAYOUT <- energyRt::report_layout()
```

```{r en-css, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_css(fmt)
```

```{r en-logo, results='asis'}
if (length(params$logos) > 0) {
  energyRt::report_img_row(params$logos, frac_total = 0.9, output = fmt)
}
```

```{r en-header, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_header(params$name, params$desc,
                        image_file = params$image_file, output = fmt)
```

```{r en-body, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_sec("Key facts", output = fmt)
tbl(params$info_df)
if (!is.null(params$draw_file)) {
  emit_img(params$draw_file, .LAYOUT$side)
}
```

```{r en-routes, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$routes_df)}
tbl(params$routes_df, caption = "Routes", max_rows = 40)
```

```{r en-trade, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$trade_df)}
tbl(params$trade_df, caption = "Availability and efficiency", max_rows = 40)
```

```{r en-aeff, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$aeff_df)}
tbl(params$aeff_df, caption = "Auxiliary commodity rates", max_rows = 25)
```

```{r en-costs, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$invcost_df) || !is.null(params$fixom_df) || !is.null(params$varom_df)}
energyRt::report_sec("Costs", output = fmt)
tbl(params$invcost_df, caption = "Investment cost")
tbl(params$fixom_df, caption = "Fixed O&M")
tbl(params$varom_df, caption = "Variable O&M")
```

```{r en-capacity, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$capacity_df)}
tbl(params$capacity_df, caption = "Capacity", max_rows = 30)
```

```{r en-map, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$map_plot)}
energyRt::report_sec("Route map", output = fmt)
emit_img(energyRt::report_plot_png(params$map_plot, 6.5, 4.5), 0.9)
```

```{r en-levcost, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$levcost_df)}
tbl(params$levcost_df, caption = "Levelized cost of transport")
```
